reason: A Chrome side-panel companion that connects a local dsh agent to browser pages, selected HTTP traffic, and browser control tools, with automation as its primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 将本地 dsh 智能体接入 Chrome 侧边栏，使其能够读取当前网页、按需捕获活动标签页的 HTTP 流量并执行导航、点击和开标签页等浏览器操作。
summaries.en: Connects a local dsh agent to a Chrome side panel so it can read the current page, capture active-tab HTTP traffic on request, and perform browser actions such as navigation, clicking, and opening tabs.

capabilities: Captures active-tab HTTP request and response data on request
Navigates, clicks, and opens browser tabs
Embeds a local agent web UI in a Chrome side panel
